ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As the figure shows, $\angle AOB$ is a right angle, $\angle AOC=50^\circ$, $ON$ is the bisector of $\angle AOC$, and $OM$ is the bisector of $\angle BOC$. What is the measure of $\angle MON$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle AOB$ is a right angle,\\
it follows that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle BOC = \angle AOB + \angle AOC = 90^\circ + 50^\circ = 140^\circ$.\\
Since OM bisects $\angle BOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle COM = \frac{1}{2} \angle BOC = 70^\circ$.\\
Since ON bisects $\angle AOC$,\\
it follows that $\angle CON = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOC = 25^\circ$.\\
Therefore, $\angle MON = \angle COM - \angle CON = 70^\circ - 25^\circ = \boxed{45^\circ}$.
